lead.t: Sunlight exposure with ultraviolet radiation induces pyrimidine dimer formation that is ordinarily countered through the action of excision repair gene products.

snip.t: Sunlight exposure with ultraviolet radiation induces pyrimidine dimer formation that is ordinarily countered through the action of excision repair gene products.
○ Risk factors: Gi disturbance (diarrhea/vomiting) - exclusive breastfeeding - liver/pancreas/kidney\ndiseases - decrease sunlight exposure - cystic fibrosis
Common examples include human height, which varies continuously across a population, and skin color, determined by multiple genes and affected by sunlight exposure.
